nodes.role_raw: thermo-optic phase shifter (single-waveguide with integrated heater)
nodes.notes: Low-loss, low-power thermo-optic phase shifter. Devices are placed in an array with center-to-center pitch along +y. Optical path oriented parallel across the array (same propagation direction for all eight). Include integrated heater and electrical routing/pads within this block (do not break out heater as separate component). Specify target phase tuning range (e.g., ≥2π) and electrical constraints (max power/voltage/current) during implementation.

notes: Arrange 8 identical phase shifters in parallel with repetition along the y-axis; use a uniform y-pitch to meet fabrication and electrical routing DRCs.
Provide one optical input and one optical output per phase shifter (total 16 optical ports) unless otherwise specified; align ports to enable easy edge/fiber-array coupling or on-chip routing.

Route heater electrical connections for each phase shifter to pads/bus lines without crossing optical waveguides where possible; maintain consistent pad placement (e.g., at one side of the array) for probing/packaging.
Minimize optical loss via adiabatic transitions into/out of the phase-shifter section; keep bends/routing outside the active heated region.
